answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to plant a violet stake tree in a shared orchard of established peers: each new alias must secure fresh countersignatures from distinct non-related agents who lock their own ocean of capital, forfeited if the tree is later flagged as a farm. The number of unique sponsors demanded scales with the count of suspected siblings, so a bulk attacker cannot recycle the same sponsors and must recruit ever more unrelated stakers who refuse to risk capital on fakes.
